global_layer.context: A single continuous wide take of a thunderstorm rolling over a wheat field at dusk.
global_layer.description: Dark storm clouds churn over a golden wheat field bending in the wind; a lightning bolt strikes in the distance followed by thunder.

aesthetics.color_scheme: slate-blue clouds, golden wheat, a flash of white lightning

audio_baseline.ambience: strong wind rushing through the wheat, distant rumbling thunder

lighting_baseline.conditions: dusk under heavy storm clouds, a band of light at the horizon
lighting_baseline.shadows: no hard shadows, flat stormy light
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: an endless field of ripe wheat under a vast sky of rolling storm clouds, a lone tree on the horizon

camera_cinematography.overall_camera_style: locked-off wide shot on a tripod

segment_basic_info.segment_description: Wind sweeps waves across the wheat as the clouds roll toward the camera.

camera_delta.camera_position: eye level, standing in the field

causal_events.effect_outcome: waves ripple across the wheat field

causal_events.physics: a branching bolt connects cloud to ground

causal_events.effect_outcome: grey rain sheets sweep across the field
